newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA OTC MARKET PRICES MIXED IN SLACK TRADING.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA OTC MARKET PRICES MIXED IN SLACK TRADING.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market saw thin trading on Wednesday with share prices tracking sideways and turnover drifting lower, brokers said.
"There have been a few orders on the ask side with most players seeking better prices," said one trader. "Low liquidity of the market might keep trading subdued for a while."
Gainers outnumbered losers in late trading by 213 to 129. Prices for 286 stocks stayed flat. Turnover fell to 16.27 billion lei from 26.34 billion in a previous session.

State-run oil refinery Arpechim led gainers, closing 3,500 lei higher at 43,500. Other performers were cement maker Romcim which added 2,000 lei to end at 121,000, and a second oil refinery, Petrobrazi, which firmed 500 lei to 44,000.
Three independent indices computed by brokerage houses, based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched down from the previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index edged down by 0.2 percent to 6,546.1 points. The BIG-OTC lost one percent to 4,630.4 points and the CAS-RQ shed by 0.26 percent to 1,013 points.
